nodes.title: Melts down right after a full dinner
nodes.distillate_text: Full belly, same meltdown. The hunger explanation does not survive this.
nodes.body: A blocker aimed at "hungry". One clean counter-example is enough to sink a simple claim.

nodes.title: It is a bid for connection, not tiredness
nodes.distillate_text: The only explanation that made a prediction and got it right: calm nights track with one-on-one time.
nodes.body: Reframes the meltdown as a need, not a malfunction. Predicts: connect first = calmer bedtime.

nodes.title: Earlier bedtime made it worse, not better
nodes.distillate_text: The prediction of "overtired" failed — earlier meant more tears. That is disconfirming, not neutral.
nodes.body: A blocker aimed at "overtired". A failed prediction should pull confidence down, not be quietly ignored.

nodes.title: Falls apart at grandma's even with the ritual
nodes.distillate_text: A new place breaks the ritual. Even the winning path has a live threat — keep it honest.
nodes.body: A blocker on the solution. Surviving so far is not the same as solved.

nodes.title: He is hungry before bed
nodes.distillate_text: A bedtime snack should fix it. It does not. Barely standing.
nodes.body: Predicts: full belly = calm. Easy to test, and it failed.

nodes.title: He is overtired — we start too late
nodes.distillate_text: Plausible on its face, but the one night we moved bedtime earlier it got worse. On the ropes.
nodes.body: The obvious first guess. It predicts: earlier bedtime = calmer. That prediction was tested.

nodes.title: Bedtime melts down most nights
nodes.distillate_text: The 7pm routine collapses into tears 4–5 nights a week. Three explanations compete — only one has survived a test.
nodes.body: Tears, refusals, a 45-minute battle. Instead of guessing, name the competing causes and see which one makes a prediction that holds.

nodes.title: Ten minutes one-on-one first makes bedtime calm
nodes.distillate_text: Tested four nights: four calm. Small sample, but it is real signal — the premise the whole thing rests on.
nodes.body: A premise under "connection": the checkable claim that carries the weight. This is a Reason, not a restatement.

nodes.title: A 10-minute wind-down: one-on-one, then lights
nodes.distillate_text: Act on the surviving explanation. Connection first; earlier lights only as a secondary lever.
nodes.body: Built from the hypothesis that survived — not the one that sounded best.

facets.name: trigger
facets.distillate: Starts the moment screens go off — or is that a coincidence worth checking?

facets.name: consistency
facets.distillate: Worse on days with no nap — the pattern to explain.

facets.name: evidence
facets.distillate: Four of four calm nights when we did the one-on-one first.
